digest.component_or_area: blame attribution and bug causality derivation
propositions: git blame over historical trees under blobless promisor faults blobs one at a time, causing partial path failures that corrupt caused_by link derivation
_blame_file_commits currently returns empty list both on git failure and on successful-but-empty blame, making failure undetectable
derive_caused_by tallies blame results across paths and can elect a wrong culprit if some paths fail while others succeed, writing an incorrect caused_by link
_blame_file_commits must distinguish None (git failure) from empty list (successful empty blame), and derive_caused_by must abort on any per-path None
clone guidance must document measured tradeoff (1.04 GiB full vs 68.7 MiB blobless) and warn that tree:0 filter produces 3.57 GiB and must not be used
legitimate empty-blame files must not trigger derivation abort; only git command failures should cause abort
